name: Body Auras
description: Needs the Exciting build of LocalExile (github.com/marshmellion/LocalExile, branch exciting) and Python (the setup makes its effects from your own client). Works with Cosmetic Drops (body auras drop and must be owned). Every weapon effect as a Body Aura character effect (Cosmetics tab), and the auras and character effects on your minions, pets, totems, traps and mines (each its own setting, /aura in the game). With Cosmetic Drops, body auras drop like the weapon effects.
author: marshmellion
